root_cause.text: The `usbio_probe()` error path returned immediately on `usb_submit_urb()` failure without freeing the previously allocated `usbio->urb`, causing a URB memory leak in the USBIO driver’s probe routine.
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes `if (ret) return dev_err_probe(...);` to `if (ret) { dev_err_probe(...); goto err_free_urb; }` and adds the `err_free_urb:` label calling `usb_free_urb(usbio->urb);`, showing the URB was allocated but not released when submission failed.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix probe error handling to clean up the allocated URB when usb_submit_urb() fails.
intent_record.what: In usbio_probe(), the error handling after usb_submit_urb() was changed from an immediate `return dev_err_probe(dev, ret, "Submitting usb urb\n");` to a braced block that calls `dev_err_probe(dev, ret, "Submitting usb urb\n");` and then jumps to `err_free_urb`.
intent_record.how: On URB submission failure, the function no longer exits directly; instead it now follows the cleanup path, allowing previously allocated URB-related resources to be freed before returning an error. This prevents a resource leak during probe failure handling.

intent_record.intent_summary: Add a dedicated cleanup label for freeing the URB during usbio probe error handling.
intent_record.what: A new label, `err_free_urb:`, was inserted immediately before the existing `usb_free_urb(usbio->urb);` call in `usbio_probe()`, following the `usb_kill_urb(usbio->urb);` cleanup path.
intent_record.how: This change creates a distinct jump target for error handling so code can branch directly to the URB-freeing cleanup step, while still allowing the preceding unlock and URB kill cleanup to run on the existing path. It adjusts control flow during probe failure cleanup without changing the cleanup actions themselves.
